state.constitution:
# Mars camp
A Mars College camp on the low Sonoran desert by the Salton Sea: a kitchen, a living room and classroom corner, a bunk house, a fire circle, a garden and a build site.

Parity demonstrator: generated from the Mars camp manifest.

batches.note: desert palette ground, low hills to the north and east (toward the Chocolate Mountains), dry grass tufts, stones and cacti outside the camp (creosote shrubs approximated)
defined things the library lacks (kit/2): campfire, chess board, sleeping mat, small items, container, water tote

about.title: Camp Kitchen
about.what: The western building in the camp row, where residents gather for shared meals. The living room is next door to the east.

about.title: Camp Living Room
about.what: The communal hall between the kitchen and bunkhouse: classes and presentations occupy one end, with reading, computers and conversation at the other.

parts.title: Classroom corner
parts.what: The teaching end of the hall, with a display and lectern.

parts.title: Living room
parts.what: The informal reading and conversation end of the hall.

about.title: Camp Bunkhouse
about.what: The eastern building in the camp row, providing a shared sleeping room away from the kitchen and classroom.

about.title: Desert Lookout
about.what: A small raised wooden viewing deck south of the kitchen, looking out over the open camp terrain.

about.title: Mars Camp
about.what: A compact desert camp with a shared kitchen, a learning and living hall, a bunkhouse and a small lookout.
about.tour: The main buildings form a west-to-east row: kitchen, living room, bunkhouse. Classes take place in the classroom corner of the living room. The small lookout lies south of the kitchen.
